fields.label: Group
fields.description: e.g. Order and finance, Fabric, Pre-production, Production and shipping. Rows are grouped by this in the workspace.

fields.label: Owner
fields.description: Team or role responsible, e.g. Merch, Fabric, QA, PPC, Logistics

fields.label: Revised
fields.description: Defaults to Plan when not explicitly delayed.

fields.label: Status
fields.options:
Open
In Progress
At Risk
Late
Done
fields.description: Derived automatically: Done once Actual is set; Late if past Revised with no Actual; At Risk if Revised has slipped past Plan but isn't due yet; In Progress for auto-tracked milestones with no plan date whose underlying work has started; otherwise Open.

fields.label: Source Reference
fields.description: For auto-tracked milestones: the actual record and version/revision behind this row (e.g. "COST-STY-001 (Rev 2, Approved)"), fetched live - not a free-text note. For manually-added activities, an optional link back to whatever record drives it.

fields.label: Auto Key
fields.description: Internal - identifies which AUTO_TNA_MILESTONES definition this row was generated from, so re-syncing updates the same row instead of duplicating it. Empty for manually-added activities.
